mean_difference <- 0.2
sd <- 0.5
alpha <- 0.05
target_power <- 0.80
one_sided <- TRUE

cat("Study Design Parameters:\n")
cat("Mean difference (H1):", mean_difference, "units\n")
cat("Standard deviation:", sd, "units\n")
cat("Cohen's d:", effect_size_d, "\n")
cat("Significance level (α):", alpha, "\n")
cat("Target power:", target_power, "\n")
cat("Test: One-sided one-sample t-test\n")
cat("Null hypothesis: μ = 0\n")
cat("Alternative hypothesis: μ > 0\n\n")

# Critical t-value for one-sided test at alpha = 0.05
# For one-sided test, we use alpha directly (not alpha/2)
t_crit <- qt(1 - alpha, df = Inf)  # Using df = Inf approximates z-critical
cat("Critical t-value (approx. z-critical, one-sided):", t_crit, "\n")

# Non-centrality parameter: δ = d * sqrt(n)
# Power is determined by P(t_obs > t_crit | δ = d * sqrt(n))
# Using the non-central t distribution

# Function to calculate power for given sample size
power_one_sample_t <- function(n, d, alpha, one_sided = TRUE) {
  # Non-centrality parameter
  ncp <- d * sqrt(n)
  
  # Critical value
  if (one_sided) {
    t_crit_val <- qt(1 - alpha, df = n - 1)
  } else {
    t_crit_val <- qt(1 - alpha / 2, df = n - 1)
  }
  
  # Power = P(t > t_crit) under non-central t distribution
  power <- 1 - pt(t_crit_val, df = n - 1, ncp = ncp)
  return(power)
}

# Search for minimum sample size

min_n <- n_candidate[min_n_idx]

cat("Smallest n achieving >= 80% power:", min_n, "\n")
cat("Power at n =", min_n, ":", powers[min_n_idx], "\n")

# Verify the preceding design

  preceding_n <- min_n - 1
  preceding_power <- power_one_sample_t(preceding_n, effect_size_d, alpha, one_sided = TRUE)
  cat("Power at n =", preceding_n, "(preceding design):", preceding_power, "\n")
}

# Detailed results table
results_table <- data.frame(
  n = n_candidate[min_n_idx - 2:0 + 3],
  power = powers[min_n_idx - 2:0 + 3]
)
cat("\nDetailed results around minimum n:\n")

cat("\n" , "="*50, "\n")

target_power <- 0.80
one_sided <- TRUE

cat("Standard deviation:", sd, "units\n")
cat("Cohen's d:", effect_size_d, "\n")
cat("Significance level (α):", alpha, "\n")
cat("Target power:", target_power, "\n")
cat("Test: One-sided one-sample t-test\n")
cat("Null hypothesis: μ = 0\n")
cat("Alternative hypothesis: μ > 0\n\n")

t_crit <- qt(1 - alpha, df = Inf)  # Using df = Inf approximates z-critical
cat("Critical t-value (approx. z-critical, one-sided):", t_crit, "\n")
